name: next
description: INERT STAND-IN for the `next` peer dependency — NOT Next.js. Installed via `file:` so the matrix app resolves `next/*` exactly the way npm would, and versioned 15.0.0 only so @comvi/next's peer range (^14 || ^15) is satisfiable without pulling ~200 MB of Next.js and its server runtime into a plain-node bundle. The gate measures the COMVI module graph; the size harness externalizes next for the same reason (scripts/size-budgets.json: external ["next", "next/*"]). Every export throws if called: the fixtures reach these APIs through @comvi/next but never invoke them, and a stub that silently returned data could hide a real regression.
